newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Torrent 1st half 96/97 sales up.
newsitem.headline: India's Torrent 1st half 96/97 sales up.

text.p: India's Torrent Pharmaceuticals Ltd said on Tuesday that domestic sales in the first six months of 1996/97 (April-March) increased by 23 percent over the same period in 1995/96.
Domestic sales growth outstripped the industry's growth rate of 14 pecent, the statement quoted chairman U.N. Mehta as telling shareholders.
The firm's export arm, Torrent Exports Ltd, has signed a significant number of contracts, currently valued at 380 million rupees, to be executed in the next few months, the statement said.
A 50:50 joint venture with France's Sanofi SA is firmly in place and well on its way to introducing a range of products during the current year, it said.
The statement said Torrent "is slated, in a couple of years, to become one of the top three players in the pharmaceutical industry of the country".
